column5: Lays down the standing exception to re-minting -- one identity survives a generation boundary, and its non-claim is fixed with it
Fixes what the version field carries, refusing a second rendering of a fact the generation chain already tells
Structures who knows what: each artefact's .meta names only itself, so the roster is derived by the reader rather than replicated
Binds the uncovered-fiber case to a refusal at open, so the containment invariant cannot be broken unobserved
Re-freezes the amended record set at 1.0, fixing what a later version may and may not add
Makes presence unconditional, so no second absence-semantics has to be minted and carried forever
Fixes what each envelope field tells a consumer and in which regime, so a holder can tell which guarantee they have
Freezes the field set at 1.0 while stating the format still permits growth -- governs what a later version may change
Pins the wire meaning of a field the shape hash cannot see, so a transition marker is not read as a state
Draws the visibility line: envelope identifiers are consumer-facing, dragline identity operator-only
Fixes the reach of the envelope-check rule by carving the record-yielding reader out of it explicitly
Binds when purge may act on a tombstoned fiber, placing the rule inside the existing policy rather than minting one
Imposes exactly one standing obligation on every consumer's domain model, conditional on pardosa having a reader for it
Refuses a shape -- a second durable rendering of one fact -- and records the refusal so it is not re-proposed
Refuses three further shapes on named grounds, each recorded rather than left as silent absence
Sets the scope boundary that keeps the no-query-surface non-goal alive: the variant is read at migration only (spans 3/5, higher taken)
States as a non-claim what the standard does not own, so a reader does not infer a reserved value space
Fixes what the declaration must state rather than the words it must use, keeping the surface content-specified
Reports a verification procedure's verdict, with the guard proven to bite before the verdict was accepted
Structures the checking mechanism into gated and judged tiers, fixing where the loop can damp error and where it cannot
Makes the sweep a standing trigger-fired check with a curated input, closing the loop at the move that creates staleness
Refuses forever any description of the mechanism broader than its bite, which is the fails-open shape (spans 5/6, higher taken)
Corrects the record where a wrong id silently misleads, without touching the append-only regime
Fixes the two nouns for an already-ruled concept, adopting the user's own word rather than minting one
Assigns the contested word to one sense and names the yielding sense, settling a collision between two existing usages
Replaces one identifier with a name built from vocabulary the map already owns
Drops a contrastive qualifier from the surviving walk's name; behaviour is unchanged
Collapses three mechanism-named variants into one property-named variant after applying the remedy-difference test
Renames the two identifiers that named pardosa's reaction instead of the value condition; the five codes stand
Puts the schema-moved / standard-moved distinction into the names, so it is visible at the call site and not only in the spec
Preserves the five-module freeze by shedding the material into an existing home rather than growing the module set
Rations spec clauses to the one noun naming an enforced constraint, leaving the rest to rustdoc and clauses that exist
